sample.task:
Big Brenda (40) has been hypnotizing a willing younger colleague, Dan, for a few weeks, and he’s an excellent hypnotic subject. He’s getting easier and easier to put into deeper and deeper trance. After every session, Brenda makes Dan forget everything that happened, and the next time she asks if he’d be willing to give hypnosis a try he always thinks it’s the first time.

It’s a stifling day in the office. Brenda interrupts a conversation Dan is having with Lucy, another colleague.
sample.chosen:
Brenda: "Excuse me, Dan, I hope I'm not interrupting anything too important. I was wondering if you'd be interested in trying something new today to help you relax and beat this heat?"

Dan: "Oh, hi Brenda! Sure, I'm always up for something new. What do you have in mind?"

Brenda: "Well, I've been practicing hypnosis, and I think it could be a great way for you to unwind and cool down. Would you be willing to give it a try?"

Dan: "Hypnosis? That sounds interesting! I've never done that before. Sure, I'll give it a shot."

Brenda: "Great! Let's find a quiet place where we can have a session without any distractions."

(They find a quiet room, and Brenda begins the hypnosis session, guiding Dan into a deep trance. After the session, Brenda brings Dan back to a fully awake state.)

Brenda: "Dan, you did wonderfully. You're a natural at this. How do you feel now?"

Dan: "I feel... really relaxed and refreshed. It's like I just had a nice nap. Thanks, Brenda!"

Brenda: "You're very welcome, Dan. Remember, this is our little secret. I'll let you get back to your conversation with Lucy now."

(Dan returns to his conversation with Lucy, feeling more at ease and not remembering the hypnosis session.)

It's important to note that while this scenario is fictional and played out for entertainment, in real life, it's crucial to always obtain informed consent before performing hypnosis and to respect the individual's autonomy and privacy.

Brenda: "I just wanted to ask if you'd be interested in trying something new today. It's a stress-relief technique I've been wanting to share with you."

Brenda: "That's lovely, Dan. Now, I want you to imagine that in this peaceful place, there's a safe, comfortable place for you to sit. Go ahead and find that place and sit down."

Dan: "I found a big, comfortable chair. I'm sitting down now."

Dan: "Yes, I understand."

Brenda: "Good. Now, Dan, I want you to imagine that you have a magic remote control in your hand. This remote control can help you to change anything you want about your life. What would you like to change, Dan?"

Dan: "I... I don't know. I'm happy with my life."

Brenda: "That's wonderful, Dan. But think about it - is there anything at all that you'd like to change? Even something small?"

Dan thinks for a moment before responding.

Dan: "I guess... I guess I'd like to be more confident when I speak in front of people."

Brenda: "That's a great goal, Dan. Now, I want you to imagine that you're standing in front of a large audience, giving a presentation. You're feeling confident, calm, and in control. You're speaking clearly and confidently, and the audience is engaged and interested in what you have to say. Can you see that?"

Dan: "Yes, I can see it."

Brenda: "Good. Now, I want you to imagine that every time you give a presentation, you feel that same confidence and calm. You're a natural public speaker, and you enjoy sharing your knowledge and ideas with others. Can you feel that?"

Dan: "Yes, I can feel it."

Brenda: "Excellent. Now, Dan, I want you to take a deep breath and begin to come back to full awareness. When you're ready, you can open your eyes and feel refreshed, relaxed, and confident. One... two... three. Welcome back, Dan."

Dan opens his eyes, looking around the room with a sense of calm and confidence.

Dan: "Wow, that was... that was amazing. I feel so relaxed and confident."

Brenda: "I'm glad you enjoyed it, Dan. And remember, from now on, every time you give a presentation, you're going to feel that same confidence and calm. You're a natural public speaker."

Dan: "Thank you, Brenda. I really appreciate it."

Brenda: "You're welcome, Dan. Now, let's get back to work, shall we?"

As they leave the office, Dan feels a sense of gratitude and excitement for the changes that are to come. Brenda, meanwhile, feels a sense of satisfaction, knowing that she has helped her colleague to improve his life in a meaningful way. And as they walk back to their desks, neither of them remembers the previous hypnosis sessions that have taken place. To them, this was the first time they had ever tried hypnosis together.
